name: population persons
description: number of inhabitants for the drinking water supply area

name: average consumption (lppd)
description: average drinking water consumption in liter per person per day

name: leakage factor
description: leakage factor as a fraction, i.e. a value of 0.1 corresponds to 10%

name: large-scale consumption (m3/day)
description: large-scale consumption from industry, agiculture, etc. in cubic metres a day

name: number of lanes
description: number of parallel lanes in a treatment plant

name: peak demand factor
description: Factor of peak water demand, i.e. the nominal flow multiplied by the peak factor demand is the expected peak flow.

name: PLC costs (EUR)
description: Costs for PLC hardware and software
